name: Paris
notes:
LitArbi 0.9.39-beta “Paris” (build 42): a window that follows Windows, like the Mac follows macOS.
• Dark mode switches live: change Windows' app mode (Settings → Personalisation → Colours) and LitArbi follows at once, as on the Mac. The accent colour and transparency follow too.
• The ribbon is now a raised card on the translucent Windows 11 background (Mica), as in Word. Menu, tabs and ribbon are clearly separate layers.
• Mica now also works in virtual machines (Parallels, VMware) and over Remote Desktop, like Word.
• Fixed: in full screen (maximized) the menu bar, the window buttons and the status bar were partly cut off.
• Settings → Window background applies at once.
• Build 39–41: buy a licence inside the app, Ctrl+V for the licence key, clearer OCR and backup messages.
